arigidi: I eyin Allahu Ajọkẹ ẹka, aṣakẹ arunran.
english: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

arigidi: Akuku idupẹ si inaa Allahu, inẹn i kan ifẹ irin inẹn i si ja ẹka da.
english: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

arigidi: Inẹn i si tanju akuku ẹka, inẹn i si ke itanju ẹdan okoju ẹnẹn i arunran.
english: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

arigidi: Inẹn i ẹgẹn a ke ẹjọ si ọwọ o.
english: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

arigidi: Ẹdan aran nwọn o sẹn, irin iranlọwọ rin nwọn o be.
english: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path -

arigidi: Uworo awọn ẹnẹn i rin ke eje - atun yan a si ikande irin (uworo) awọn ẹnẹn arẹfọ irin (uworo)
english: awọn ẹnẹn i gbegiri dun efa. The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

arigidi: Iwe iran Jesu Kristi, uwọn ọkọre Dafidi, uwọn ọkọre Abrahamu.
source: TANTAN MAJEMU New Testament Bible Arigidi 2nd edition.pdf, p.1
